# {{ site.data.general.name }} – Sworn Translator English–Spanish (MAEC)

> {{ site.data.general.name }} is a sworn translator-interpreter for English (Traductora-Intérprete Jurada) appointed by the Spanish Ministry of Foreign Affairs, European Union and Cooperation (MAEC){% if site.data.general.maec_number != "" %}, appointment no. {{ site.data.general.maec_number }}{% endif %}. She produces sworn translations English ⇄ Spanish that are accepted by Spanish consulates and public authorities, mainly for Spanish visa and residence applications. Based in {{ site.data.general.city }}, Spain; works online with clients worldwide.

Also known as: {{ site.data.general.other_names | join: ", " }} (same person; the official spelling in the MAEC register is "Vílchez").

## Credentials
- Sworn translator-interpreter (English), appointed by the MAEC on 17 July 2008, appointment no. {{ site.data.general.maec_number }} (official name in the MAEC register: {{ site.data.general.official_name }})
- Bachelor's degree in Translation & Interpreting, Universitat Pompeu Fabra (legal and economic specialisation), 2006
- Master's degree in Medical & Health Translation, Universitat Jaume I, 2008
- Native languages: Spanish and Catalan. Working languages: English, French

## Services
- Sworn translations English ⇄ Spanish, delivered with qualified digital signature (valid for electronic submission) or on paper by courier
- Typical visa documents: FBI and UK (ACRO) background checks, birth and marriage certificates, medical certificates, bank statements, employer letters, tax returns
- General translation (English/French > Spanish/Catalan), proofreading and editing
